hook: Your teaspoon would weigh about a billion tonnes.
title: A Teaspoon of Neutron Star Weighs a Mountain
description:
A neutron star is a collapsed dead star squeezed to about the size of a city. A teaspoon of its material would weigh about a billion tonnes. That is a hill's worth of rock on one spoon.

#Shorts #NeutronStar #SpaceFacts
comment_prompt: Could you lift it? Yes or no
